title: chat.event: permission
description: The agent asks for permission (held until answered or the deadline). In chat.event it also carries type and conversation; in chat.history it does not.

whole.description: Only when the input was too long to show whole (past 64 KiB of JSON, the bound of the agent's own text): it is cut as a tool event's, "always" is false and no rules are offered, and the server takes only deny. Absent: the input is whole
